items.title: Polygon discloses security flaws fixed in recent hard forks
items.summary: The vulnerabilities posed denial-of-service and validator resource risks but were patched before Polygon publicly disclosed them.

items.title: OpenAI’s ‘Trust Us’ TIME cover raises an old warning for AI bulls
items.summary: The magazine-cover indicator has a messy record, but TIME’s OpenAI cover checks the classic boxes: a mainstream publication, a widely understood theme and a multiyear run-up in investor enthusiasm.

items.title: U.S. strikes on Iran fail to stir bitcoin, on track for best month since November 2024
items.summary: Bitcoin held steady despite a broader risk-off move after the first U.S. strikes against Iran for weeks sent oil higher and stocks lower. The cryptocurrency has gained 24% this month.

items.title: Ireland excludes crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
items.summary: Ireland’s planned investment accounts will offer tax benefits for stocks, bonds and ETFs, while excluding crypto and derivatives as higher-risk products.

items.title: Hut 8's Texas power site sits inside Anthropic’s $35 billion AI deal
items.summary: The company's Texas campus has two long-term leases worth $19.6 billion, more than 260 times its latest quarterly revenue, as AI companies race to secure power and data-center capacity.

items.title: U.S. looks to influence Japan's monetary policy. It couldn't do that with bitcoin
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Sept. 1, 2026

items.title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
items.summary: The country’s financial watchdog says its proposed stablecoin rules are aligned with U.S. and EU frameworks and that it also paves the way for the recognition of foreign stablecoin.

items.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $78,000 as Arbitrum surges 30% on Robinhood Chain revenue
items.summary: BTC drifted lower after last week's rally to $81,428, while ARB led DeFi gains as Robinhood Chain's daily fees topped $2 million.

items.title: Strategy spends $635M buying back STRC as perpetual preferred stock lags $100 par
items.summary: STRC trades at $97.34 despite Strategy’s growing repurchases, while SATA’s higher dividend rate has helped it hold its $100 par value.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades around $78,000 as crude surges, global bond sell-off deepens
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs took in $217 million on Monday, one session after an outflow ended their nine-day run. Ether ETFs have not had net outflows since mid-August.

items.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
items.summary: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.

items.title: Bitcoin steady above $78,000, HYPE leads as majors slip on hawkish Fed bets
items.summary: Ether, solana, tron and dogecoin all shed ground over 24 hours while HYPE added about 4%, leaving bitcoin flat on the week after August's 24% run.

items.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
items.summary: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

items.title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
items.summary: Outstanding XRP futures positions outside CME fell by more than 500 million tokens in two weeks, while exposure on the regulated U.S. exchange climbed about 36% as XRP rallied toward $1.40.

items.title: Lazarus Group-linked addresses move $30M through Hyperliquid
items.summary: Crypto wallets linked to the OFAC-sanctioned Lazarus Group moved $30 million in digital assets through Hyperliquid, weeks after regulators said they were working on a path to introduce the exchange into US markets.

items.title: London Stock Exchange partners with Kraken parent for tokenized UK stocks: FT
items.summary: The London bourse operator is seeking to offer 24/5 exposure to UK-based tokenized equities, as more TradFi institutions explore tokenized equities offerings.

items.title: Bitfinex Securities lists tokenized notes tied to Strategy, Metaplanet
items.summary: Five equity-backed notes issued through Luxembourg’s ORO II fund will trade against dollars, USDT and Bitcoin for eligible non-US investors.

items.title: Singapore weighs recognizing some foreign-issued stablecoins
items.summary: Singapore is considering allowing jointly issued cross-border stablecoins into its regulatory regime, revisiting its earlier decision to restrict the framework to domestic issuance.

items.title: Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital leads Polymarket’s $1B raise: Report
items.summary: Donald Trump Jr.-linked 1789 Capital will reportedly lead a $1 billion investment round into Polymarket, which would value the platform at $21 billion, just below Kalshi’s $22 billion valuation.
